mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_linkage_trigger(application_id, application_version, source_object_id, target_object_id, target_object_version, target_field_id, anchor, anchor_field_id, signature, creator, updater) VALUES (#{row.applicationId}, #{row.applicationVersion}, #{row.sourceObjectId}, #{row.targetObjectId}, #{row.targetObjectVersion}, #{row.targetFieldId}, #{row.anchor}, #{row.anchorFieldId}, #{row.signature}, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('applicationId', a.id::text, 'name', a.app_name, 'version', a.published_version, 'objects', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(o ->> 'objectId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.definition_json -> 'definition' -> 'objects') o))::text FROM public.nocode_application a JOIN public.nocode_application_version v ON v.application_id = a.id AND v.version_no = a.published_version AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.id <> #{except} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.definition_json -> 'definition' -> 'objects') o WHERE o ->> 'objectId' = CAST(#{object} AS text)) ORDER BY a.id
